items.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
items.excerpt: Beeble unveiled SwitchHDR, an AI model that reconstructs HDR imagery from standard SDR footage, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences for professional VFX and post pipelines. 'Where real detail survives we recover it; where it's fully clipped, the artist decides how it gets rebuilt,' says CEO Hoon Kim.

items.title: NVIDIA 'Neural Rendering, World Models and Simulation' Keynote Set for SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: NVIDIA Research leaders Neil Ashton, Ming-Yu Liu and Edward Liu will deliver a SIGGRAPH 2026 keynote on advances in neural rendering, world models and AI-driven simulation, signaling where generative graphics for film and VFX are headed.

items.title: Lightcraft Launches Beta for Spark Story Interactive Previz Tool
items.excerpt: Lightcraft opened a rolling beta of Spark Story, an interactive previz tool that lets filmmakers block scenes, populate asset libraries and render full-quality 'superdailies' in real time — working with AI or blue/greenscreen keyers to compress previsualization and cut early production costs.

items.title: Adobe adds experimental AI Playground to Project Indigo camera app
items.excerpt: Adobe added an experimental AI Playground to its Project Indigo computational-photography app, letting shooters apply generative editing directly after capture — pushing on-device generative image manipulation well beyond simple style transfer.
